# AI Study Workbench (`socratic-workbench`)

> A cross-agent AI study coach skill (`SKILL.md`) that turns ChatGPT, Claude Code, Antigravity, Codex, and Cursor into a spoiler-free human mentor for learning English, textbooks, coding, and exams.

## What It Solves
Standard AI tutors spoil answers immediately or silently patch bugs in code you barely understood. `socratic-workbench` keeps questions in a blind practice sheet (`workbench.md`), locks answers inside a separate rubric (`answer_key.md`), hides its own system prompt rules from the user, and coaches through realistic roleplay, counterexamples, and 4-step plain-language coding drills.

## Four Built-In Learning Tracks
- **English & Foreign Languages (`english`)**: [track-english.md](skills/socratic-workbench/references/track-english.md) — Live roleplay sparring, error nudging without upfront sample translations, and natural phrasing upgrades.
- **Textbooks & Any Course (`textbook`)**: [track-textbook.md](skills/socratic-workbench/references/track-textbook.md) — Chapter big picture, common misconception traps, and real-world concept checks before formulas.
- **Coding & System Design (`coding`)**: [track-coding.md](skills/socratic-workbench/references/track-coding.md) — Write logic in 4 plain-language steps; AI compiles syntax 1:1 without silent fixes; real tests break blind spots; learn 1–2 clean idioms after passing.
- **Exams & Interviews (`interview`)**: [track-interview.md](skills/socratic-workbench/references/track-interview.md) — Point-counted blind recall, incident twist probing, and concise bold-keyword review cards.

## Install & Usage
- **Agent Skill**: [SKILL.md](skills/socratic-workbench/SKILL.md) (compatible with `npx skills`, Antigravity `.agents/skills/`, Claude Code `.claude/skills/`, Codex)
- **Cursor Rule**: [socratic-workbench.mdc](adapters/cursor/socratic-workbench.mdc)
- **Web LLMs**: [English Prompt](adapters/web-llm/system-prompt.en.md) | [Chinese Prompt](adapters/web-llm/system-prompt.zh-CN.md)
- **CLI Scaffolder & Checker**: [init_workbench.py](skills/socratic-workbench/scripts/init_workbench.py)
